sources.entry: Messenger - macOS app wrapping Facebook's Messenger for desktop.

summary.one_liner: A Mac app that wraps Facebook's stand-alone Messenger in a native macOS window, described as an unofficial hobby project.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes the project as a Mac app wrapper around Facebook's stand-alone Messenger. It is explicitly stated to be an unofficial hobby project and not a Facebook product. The README links to a latest release download and to distribution statistics, which are not reproduced in the text. It notes a separate download, version 0.1.4, for users on OS X 10.9. The code is released under the MIT license. The README gives no details about features, build steps, or implementation.
use_cases: run Facebook Messenger as a desktop app on Mac
chat with Facebook contacts outside a browser tab
install a Messenger wrapper on OS X 10.9
how_to_run: Download the latest release from the project's releases page (linked in the README)
notable: Wraps Facebook's stand-alone Messenger as a Mac app
Unofficial hobby project, not affiliated with Facebook
Separate legacy build (0.1.4) for OS X 10.9
caveats: Unofficial hobby project, not a Facebook product
README gives little detail on features or current maintenance status
Legacy build offered specifically for OS X 10.9
